title: cyathea poolii
intro: Cyathea poolii, commonly known as the New Caledonian tree fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Cyathea genus and is native to New Caledonia. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyathea poolii include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, making it a potential remedy for several health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
